c.tagline: France's Indian coast — mustard villas, a sea-facing promenade, and Tamil-French soul.

taxi.fareNote: Auto-rickshaws are the everyday ride but rarely use the meter — agree the fare before boarding, or use an app cab (Ola/Uber, availability is limited). Rented scooters and bicycles are the most popular way to explore compact White Town.

emergency.note: 112 is India's single all-in-one emergency number reaching police, fire, and ambulance; 100 reaches police directly and 108 is the dedicated ambulance line.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.White Town (French Quarter): White Town Pondicherry French Quarter promenade

avoid.reason: Weekend drinking crowds from Chennai, touts near the promenade, and isolated beaches after dark warrant extra awareness.

hood_desc: The former French Quarter of mustard-yellow villas with blue shutters, tree-lined grid streets, cafes, and boutiques, running down to the seafront Promenade (Rock Beach), the lighthouse, Bharathi Park, and the Sri Aurobindo Ashram; best for first-timers who want the postcard Pondicherry within walking distance.

The livelier Tamil (Ville Noire) side of the canal around Mission Street, the Grand Bazaar (Goubert Market), and the Hindu and Muslim quarters along Vysial and Cazy streets, lined with colorful Franco-Tamil heritage homes; suits travelers wanting local markets, temples, and authentic South Indian food.

The experimental international township 10 km north, centered on the golden Matrimandir meditation dome, with eco-guesthouses, organic cafes, craft studios, and forest cycling paths; suits travelers seeking a quiet, spiritual, community-focused stay away from the town.

A laid-back stretch of coast at Kottakuppam north of town, Pondicherry's main surf spot, with beach shacks, cafes, yoga schools, and guesthouses; suits younger travelers, surfers, and those wanting a relaxed seaside base.

A quieter residential pocket just north of White Town near the sea, blending French-style streets with local Tamil life; good for those wanting calm and proximity to the promenade without the tourist bustle.

Maison Perumal - A CGH Earth Experience

water.note: Drink bottled or filtered water only.

transit.pay: Fares are paid in cash directly to the conductor on board town buses (a few rupees per ride); auto-rickshaws are negotiated in cash and increasingly accept UPI/QR payment. There is no rechargeable transit card as of 2026.
transit.hours: Town buses run roughly 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM; auto-rickshaws and app cabs cover late-night travel.
transit.note: Compact Puducherry has no metro or tram; town buses, auto-rickshaws, and rented scooters or bicycles are the main ways to get around, and White Town is easily walked.

train: Puducherry Railway Station (limited services; Villupuram Junction ~35 km connects to the mainline network and Chennai Egmore)
bus: PRTC/TNSTC New Bus Stand with frequent services to Chennai, Bengaluru, and across Tamil Nadu

transit.m: Auto-rickshaw or app cab to White Town (~15-20 min)
Town bus from the nearby stop to Puducherry New Bus Stand
Chennai International Airport (MAA) ~150 km / 3-4 hr by road or bus for wider domestic and international connections

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up or leaving 5-10% at restaurants for good service is appreciated. Small tips to hotel and auto drivers are common.
